Delivered per plan: (1) DET caused_by floor — epic_bug_floor_findings blocks an epic close exactly like an unclosed child when an open/in_progress bug records caused_by into the subtree; floor read errors withhold certification instead of blocking (mirrors child-closure read-error arm). compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Agents file bugs outside an epic's hierarchy during epic execution and deem them out-of-scope/pre-existing even when they are defects in the epic's own deliverable; the direct-children close gate cannot see them. Event-precise backtest over 56 analyzable epic closes: 2 real at-close escapes (30a2 token-bin scaling under the token-reduction epic a492; 5b09 artifact persistence under 119f), and legitimate deferrals that must NOT block (30d3 proven-pre-existing fsck diagnostics; e6a0 filed-49s-before-close architectural follow-up, later its own epic; c8ed bug supersedes an investigation epic). 'Open linked bug' alone is not the discriminator — causation is. Incentive risk: the check keys on voluntary links; blocking legitimate deferrals teaches agents to stop linking.

## Approach
Three stages at epic close (verify-completion, epic path only):
1. DET floor: any OPEN/IN_PROGRESS bug with caused_by -> epic or any descendant = deterministic block (like the direct-children gate, completion.py ~:90). Reverse-edge read primitive, concretely: caused_by is DIRECTIONAL, stored on the BUG's own compiled deps[] with no reciprocal on the epic side — so the floor (and the stage-2 filter) enumerate open/in_progress bugs via the list-tickets read and scan each bug's deps[] for edges whose target resolves into the epic-subtree id set; the epic's own deps[] cannot supply these edges. Semantically unambiguous; 0 historical FPs; teaches: fix it, re-parent it, or dispute the link. Known-limited standalone coverage (caused_by edges are mostly auto-derived at a bug's own close, so open orphans rarely carry one) — the floor is the cheap deterministic tier; coverage of unlinked orphans comes from stages 2-3.
2. DET candidate filter for the screen: status in {open,in_progress} AND type=bug AND (created after the epic's FIRST in_progress transition OR linked any-relation/any-depth to the epic subtree, both directions). Timing-anchor read primitive: the first open->in_progress STATUS event from the epic's event directory, read WITH retired tombstones (the event_metrics._event_files idiom, include_retired=True — snapshot compaction folds old events, so the compiled state alone cannot supply it). Fallback when NO in_progress event exists at all (epic closed straight from open, or predates the workflow): anchor on the epic's creation timestamp — wider window, safe direction (over-inclusion only feeds the cheap screen). Backtested fan-out: median 3, p90 11, max 24 (descriptive, not a bound). Enforced screen ceiling: at most 32 candidates are evaluated per close — linked-to-subtree candidates first, then by created timestamp descending — and any remainder is recorded in the sidecar tally as an unevaluated-overflow count (visible to the operator, never silently dropped). Commit-relation criterion evaluated and REJECTED: 0 unique catches, 2 FPs, 58% of bug-cited SHAs already unresolvable (Gerrit rebase rot), and comment-hygiene work drains SHA citations from bug bodies going forward.
3. Haiku relevance screen: single-turn per candidate, forced choice {A: describes a defect in something this epic changed/built or behavior its AC claims; B: same subsystem, pre-existing or adjacent; C: unrelated} + one-line citation. Epic material (title/description/AC/children titles) in the system prompt for prompt caching; one warm call then parallel fan-out, reusing the warm-then-fan-out orchestration pattern of plan_review/pass1.py (extract the shared helper only if it lifts cleanly; otherwise mirror the pattern with a citation comment — no speculative refactor of pass1). MUST ride the model-class config + shared cache settings (bug afeb-bc04: hand-built LLM sub-calls bypass model-class config — do not add another instance; bug 7a79: 4096-token cache floor means small epics may not cache — acceptable, haiku is cheap uncached).
Forward A-verdicts to the completion verifier as compact evidence: title + screen citation + ticket id (~40 tokens each), cap 8 with titles-only overflow count. Forwarding path, concretely: the compact candidate block is appended INSIDE the fenced context assembled by completion_precheck (src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py:45, via operations.assemble_context) as a clearly-delimited 'unresolved bug candidates' section — no completion_precheck_output schema change. The verifier's native read-only show_ticket tool retrieves detail on demand — no context squeeze, no new plumbing. Screen output contract follows the overlap_verdict idiom (contracts.py:175): a prompt file with `outputs:` naming a new epic_bug_screen_verdict schema registered in contracts.py — forced choice A/B/C + one-line citation — with a normalizing validator; no hand-rolled JSON parsing. The validator's normalization DEFAULT is C (unrelated): any out-of-vocabulary, malformed, or missing verdict coerces to the non-surfacing value, mirroring overlap_verdict's safe default (related_distinct) — a garbled screen output degrades open and never fabricates an A-candidate. Verifier directive (landed as an edit to src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md, where the adjudication rule lives next to the context it reads): block only a defect-in-deliverable with NO recorded disposition. A disposition SATISFIES via store-grounded signals the verifier checks through show_ticket — (a) a supersedes or duplicates link (either direction) connecting the bug to the epic subtree or to a named successor ticket, or (b) a reasoned pre-existence/deferral assertion in the bug's description or comments, judged for substance (a bare 'out of scope' does not qualify). close_class NEVER satisfies (it exists only on closed bugs; candidates are open/in_progress by construction). Fixture mapping: c8ed satisfies via (a) (carries a real supersedes link to the investigation epic); 30d3 via (b) (description proves pre-existence); e6a0 via (b) (its supersession exists ONLY as comment prose — 'Superseded by epic 4702-a55c-7aeb-445a…' — with no supersedes/duplicates link; store verified). Prose-only supersession is intentionally handled by (b), not (a): (a) is the link-shaped fast path, (b) is the substance-judged prose path, and e6a0 proves the common case where agents record supersession in prose without linking. This protects the linking incentive. Record the full screen tally (per-bug verdict + citation) in the completion sidecar for audit and live FN calibration. Screen failure degrades open (log + skip), never blocks the close by itself; the DET floor is the hard tier. --force-close remains the operator escape hatch.

## Scope
- src/rebar/llm/completion.py (DET floor beside the direct-children gate; candidate filter)
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py (completion_precheck: (i) the DET-floor ENFORCEMENT short-circuit, mirroring the unclosed-child gate at ~:63-74 — an open/in_progress caused_by bug returns run_verify=False + precheck_failed=True + a deterministic FAIL verdict (same shape as deterministic_child_failure), NO LLM call; (ii) append compact candidates into the fenced context; no output-schema change)
- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md (adjudication directive + disposition rule)
- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/epic_bug_screen.md (new prompt, `outputs: epic_bug_screen_verdict`) + the full three-file overlap_verdict registration idiom: src/rebar/llm/contracts.py (response model + normalizing validator), src/rebar/schemas/epic_bug_screen_verdict.schema.json (the JSON schema), and src/rebar/schemas/__init__.py (EPIC_BUG_SCREEN_VERDICT constant + __all__ + prompt->schema map entry, mirroring OVERLAP_VERDICT at ~:130/:318)
- new module for the screen (module-size policy: keep completion.py under cap), e.g. src/rebar/llm/epic_bug_screen.py
- src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py (screen tally recording)
- docs/plan-review-gate.md (close-gate section) + docs/llm-framework.md
- tests: unit for filter + floor + forwarding cap; regression fixtures below

## Testing
Regression set from the event-precise backtest — must-block: 30a2-4f2a, 5b09-4f3d (real at-close deliverable defects). Must-pass: 30d3-eaf0 (description proves pre-existence), e6a0-ba9b (disposition trail: filed then superseded by epic 4702), c8ed-d52d (supersedes an investigation epic — investigate/file/close is correct). Documented-unreachable, assert NOT flagged: 5e94-3841 (created 13 days post-close), 22f5-5a48 (fixed during epic, 2h before close). DET floor unit tests: open caused_by bug blocks; closed caused_by bug passes; discovered_from alone does not trip the floor. Filter unit tests: timing window uses FIRST in_progress transition; any-depth link traversal both directions. Screen: fan-out cap, warm-then-parallel ordering, degrade-open on model failure, tally lands in sidecar. All regression/unit tests are LLM-free at BOTH tiers: the screen runs through a FAKE forced-choice verdict map, AND the verifier decision path is faked/stubbed — automated must-block fixtures assert the DET-floor short-circuit (caused_by cases) or assert UP TO the forwarded candidate block (content + cap + overflow in the assembled fenced context); automated must-pass fixtures assert no floor trip and correct candidate forwarding. The REAL verifier's store-grounded disposition adjudication (30a2+5b09 block; 30d3/e6a0/c8ed pass) is proven exclusively in the [operator-attested] live calibration AC — matching the repo's LLM-test idiom; the live haiku path likewise runs only in that calibration.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] DET caused_by floor blocks epic close with an open/in_progress caused_by bug in the subtree, with a teaching message (fix / re-parent / dispute link).
- [x] Candidate filter implements exactly: open|in_progress bugs AND (created-after-first-in_progress OR linked-any-relation-any-depth); commit-relation is NOT implemented.
- [x] Screen rides model-class config + shared cache settings (no hand-built client), forced-choice output with citation, parallel after cache warm.
- [x] Verifier receives at most 8 compact candidates (title+citation+id) + overflow count inside the precheck-assembled fenced context (verified by a forwarding unit test on the assembled string).
- [x] Verifier adjudicates via show_ticket on demand and blocks only undispositioned deliverable-defects per the store-grounded disposition rule — (a) supersedes/duplicates link, or (b) reasoned pre-existence/supersession prose; never close_class (verified by the must-block/must-pass regression fixtures).
- [x] Screen verdict rides a registered output schema + normalizing validator (overlap_verdict idiom); verifier directive text lands in completion_verifier.md.
- [x] Screen tally recorded in the completion sidecar, including the unevaluated-overflow count when the 32-candidate screen ceiling truncates; screen failure degrades open with a logged reason.
- [x] Full regression set above encoded as tests (must-block, must-pass, not-flagged).
- [x] docs/plan-review-gate.md close-gate section documents the three-stage gate (DET floor, candidate filter, screen + disposition rule) and docs/llm-framework.md references the epic_bug_screen prompt/schema.
- [x] [operator-attested] One live calibration run over the regression fixtures recorded on this ticket: (i) per-bug haiku A/B/C tally with timestamp, proving the real model -> epic_bug_screen_verdict validator path end-to-end, AND (ii) the verifier's block/pass outcome per fixture through the REAL disposition rule (live run 2026-08-03: 30a2 block; 30d3/e6a0/c8ed pass; 5b09 pass — original must-block adjudication corrected against snapshot evidence of pre-close production recovery, see calibration comment); automated tests stay on the fake verdict map.
